main_idea: On-policy distillation lifts GDPval net win-loss margin by about 21% on two model families
ideas: On-policy distillation improves GDPval across two model families
Student learns from its own rollouts scored by teacher
Net win-loss margin vs base is +20.9% and +21.4%
Mean rubric score rose 5.1 and 7.9 points
summary: The two large net-margin stats are the clear main visual, but the slogan headline, eyebrow, pipeline diagram, secondary rubric row, and repeated URL clutter it; nothing needed is missing.
